name: Icewind Dale (Complete)
caption: Everything for running Rime of the Frostmaiden in Vagabond.
description:
Imports the full conversion into this world, with its folder structure intact:

  • 207 monsters in eight Being Type folders.
  • 229 NPCs — Villains, Key NPCs, and one folder per chapter. 211 are named individuals; each sheet records which stat block it is built on.
  • 74 magic items in six folders, priced from Vagabond's official Powers table.
  • 11 encounter maps — 25×25 at 100px, pre-lit for the Everlasting Rime: perpetual darkness with dim ambient light, so torches and darkvision matter.
  • 10 roll tables — six regional encounter tables, plus weather, cold exposure, scavenging and chwinga gifts.
  • 3 reference journals — Ten-Towns quests, the main arc, and the house rules used in this conversion.

Requires the Vagabond system (5.4.1+). Contains no published adventure text.

A hibernating bear. Wakes hungry and hostile, but flees at 20 HP or fewer if the verbeeg is out of sight.

Stat block: Brown Bear

system.description: Two Claws and a Bite. If both Claws hit the same Target, the Bite can automatically hit that Target.
Grapples and Shoves as Large.

details.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion), Chapter 2: Icewind Dale
details.description:
Human frost druid working as a guide.

A convert to Auril's winter, who has stopped asking the land for anything and started asking the cold instead.

Stat block: Frost Druid

system.description: 2×Ice Sickle
It transforms into a fox, mountain goat, owl, or wolf, and back. Its statistics are unchanged, but it gains that beast's movement.
It ignores the effects of extreme cold and treats icy ground as normal footing.

details.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion), Chapter 5: Auril's Abode
details.description:
Nass Lantomir's arctic weasel familiar.

Zelennor, Nass Lantomir's arctic familiar, and every other small thing in the snow with teeth.

Stat block: Weasel

system.description: It has Favor on Checks that rely on hearing or smell.

details.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion), Chapter 2: Icewind Dale
details.description:
Gnome squidling aboard the Id Ascendant.

A ceremorphosis that stalled halfway. Rin, Rix, and Zglarrd are pitiable, and still hungry.

Stat block: Gnome Squidling

system.description: 5 (2d4) A Medium or smaller target is Grappling, and must pass [Will] or be Dazed while the grapple holds.
2 (d4) Targets that fail are Dazed until the end of their next Turn.

Icewind kobold.

A shivering little opportunist that has learned to dig deep and strike from the dark - alone, it's nothing; in a pack, it's a problem.

Stat block: Icewind Kobold

system.description: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

Duergar accompanying Durth Sunblight.

A grim, gray-skinned dwarf of Xardorok's rank and file, unhappy to be here and twice as unhappy to see you.

Stat block: Duergar

(Recharge Cd6) It is Invisible for up to 1 Hour, until it Attacks, Casts, or its Focus breaks.

Lore: Relic Chest

An abracadabrus never runs in the same family twice - the ones that survive tend to end up in the hands of merchants clever enough not to ask for soup twice in one day.

A gemstone-studded chest with a 1.5-foot cubic interior. It has 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. As an Action, touch the closed lid and spend 1 charge while naming one or more nonmagical objects worth 1g or less total - they appear inside, provided they fit and the chest is otherwise empty. Food and drink conjured this way are delicious but spoil after 24 Hours; conjured gems or precious metals crumble to nothing after 1 Minute.

It has the following Powers:

  • Cornucopia: 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Spend a charge to conjure nonmagical items worth up to 1g in total inside the chest - food, drink, rope, kindling. Conjured matter vanishes after a Rest.

Value: 4000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Jug

A ceramic jug that produces whatever it feels like producing, within reason. It has the following Powers:

  • Endless Draught: Once per Rest, name a liquid - water, ale, oil, honey, vinegar, wine, or mayonnaise - and the jug fills with it.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Amulet (Bound)

Found in the Black Cabin, where Macreadus apparently valued it less than his machine. It has the following Powers:

  • Vigour: The wearer's Might score becomes 19 if it isn't already higher.

Value: 10000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Bag (Consumable)

Perfectly ordinary beans. That is the problem. It has the following Powers:

  • Sprouting: Plant a bean and something happens - a treant, a geyser, a rain of toads, or a small, extremely angry monster. Roll on the DM's table.

Value: 2000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Bag

Confiscated from Dzaan by the Easthaven militia and never entered into evidence. It has the following Powers:

  • Menagerie: Reach in and pull out a fuzzy object, which becomes a random Beast that obeys you. Three uses, which return after a Rest.

Value: 3000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Battleaxe (Bound)

Vassavicken's axe. It wants to be swung, and it is not especially concerned at what. It has the following Powers:

  • (+2) Weapon: Deals an extra +2 damage.
  • (+1) Armor: +1 bonus to Armor while the axe is carried.
  • Anger: The wielder always fails Saves against Berserk. While Berserk they must Attack the nearest Being each Turn, and cannot willingly part with the axe.

Value: 1350g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Boots (Bound)

Hilda's thanks for bringing her children home. It has the following Powers:

  • Resistance: Favor on Saves and damage reduction against Cold; the wearer is unharmed by Blistering Cold.
  • Snowstrider: Ice and deep snow are never Difficult Terrain for the wearer.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cauldron

Carved with reposing satyrs and nymphs holding ladles, the cauldron has fed more than one desperate Ten-Towns supper table through the darkest weeks of the Everlasting Rime.

A 4-foot copper cauldron on five clawed feet, holding up to 30 gallons. Stir water in it for 1 Minute and it becomes a hearty stew - one nourishing meal per gallon for up to 4 people. The stew stays hot inside the cauldron and cools naturally once removed; the cauldron itself never gets hot to the touch.

Usable 3 times, refreshing after a Rest.

It has the following Powers:

  • Endless Stew: Stir water in it for 1 Minute to fill it with hearty stew: one nourishing meal for up to 12 Beings. Usable 3 times, refreshing after a Rest.

Value: 1500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Chime

A hollow mithral tube that Netherese librarians used instead of keys. It has the following Powers:

  • Opening: Strike the chime to Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.q52wvmwELTAsuPgM]{Knock} on one object within Near. Three uses, after which the chime cracks and is spent.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cloak (Bound)

The wearer is easy to overlook, and the cloak's colour never quite settles. It has the following Powers:

  • Invisibility I: While the hood is up, skip your Move to become Invisible until after you take an Action. Beings have Hinder on Checks to notice you even after that.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cloak (Bound)

Wyrmdoom Crag's goliaths have kept this one in the main hall for generations. It has the following Powers:

  • (+1) Armor: +1 bonus to Armor while worn.
  • (+1) Protection: +1 bonus to all Saves while worn.

Value: 1100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Orb (Bound)

Nass Lantomir wanted one badly enough to die over it. It has the following Powers:

  • Scrying: Gaze into it to Scry on a Being or place you name, seeing and hearing it as though standing there. An unwilling Being resists with [Will], and knows it is being watched on a pass.
  • True-Seeing: While Scrying, the viewer sees through illusions, invisibility and disguises within the scried area.

Value: 50000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Globe

A glass sphere the size of a fist that follows its owner around like a patient dog. It has the following Powers:

  • Radiant I: Speak the command word to make it shed sunlight out to Close, and again to douse it.
  • Levitation: The globe itself hovers, and follows within Close of whoever spoke the command word. It can be sent up to Far away and recalled.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Gem (Consumable)

A flawed yellow diamond with something restless behind the facets. It has the following Powers:

  • Summon Elemental: Shatter it to summon a friendly Earth Elemental for 1 Hour.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cell (Consumable)

A flat crystalline wafer holding a charge that no Faerunian magic can replenish. It has the following Powers:

  • Charge Store: Holds 5 charges. Nothing in Faerun can refill it - once spent, it is inert forever.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Lenses

Netherese reading glasses, found in the captains' quarters of the Id Ascendant. It has the following Powers:

  • Minute Seeing: The wearer has Favor on Checks to examine anything within 1 foot.

Value: 500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Figurine

A goliath peace offering, and a rather good messenger. It has the following Powers:

  • Silver Raven: Becomes a living silver raven for up to 12 Hours, then reverts and can't be used again until after a Rest. It can carry a message.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Hat (Bound)

Pekoe Quint's, and it explains a great deal about Pekoe Quint. It has the following Powers:

  • Disguise: Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.rk2GSVwSxOLSOozU]{Mirage} on yourself at will to change your appearance. The illusion ends if the hat leaves your head.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Hook

Dockside anglers in Termalaine swear by the hook, even the ones who've been walloped by an indignant flying fish for their trouble.

A tiny silver fishhook with a gold feather tied to it. Tie it to a line and immerse it in at least a 10-foot cube of water. At the end of each uninterrupted Hour of immersion, roll a d6 - on a 6, a floppy 6-inch magical fish appears on the hook. Roll or choose on the table below. Once it conjures a fish, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

d8FishEffect
1-4Green, copper bandsA day's nourishment for one creature if eaten within 24 Hours, then it rots.
5-6Yellow, black stripesThrown up to Far at a Being it can see: pass [Reflex] or be knocked Prone. The fish then vanishes.
7Blue, white bandsSprouts wings and sings sweetly, following you around for 2d4 Hours or until it drops to 0 HP (HD: 1, 4 HP, Fly 30').
8Gold, silver stripesA day's nourishment and 2d10 temporary HP if eaten within 24 Hours, then it rots.

It has the following Powers:

  • Fisher's Luck: At the end of each uninterrupted Hour immersed in at least a 10-foot cube of water, roll d6. On a 6 it lands a fish large enough to feed 1d4 Beings; on a 1 it lands something that objects.

Value: 500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Horn

Blowing it is always louder than anyone expects, including the person blowing it. It has the following Powers:

  • Thunderblast: Blow the horn to deal 5d6 damage in a Far Cone; those who fail [Endure] are also Dazed. On a roll of 1-4 on a d100, the horn explodes and is destroyed, dealing 10d6 to the user.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Lantern

A common tool of Ten-Towns militia and monster hunters alike, cheap enough to hand out to every watch post that can't afford a real scout.

A hooded lantern burning 6 Hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light to Near and dim light to Far. Each lantern of tracking is bound to a single Being Type, rolled once when it's found and never changed. While within roughly 300 feet of any Being of that Type, its flame burns bright green - though it doesn't pinpoint a direction or distance.

d8Being Type
1Artificial
2Beast
3Cryptid
4Fae
5Humanlike
6Outer
7Primordial
8Undead

It has the following Powers:

  • Moonlit II: Sheds bright light to Near and dim light to Far, burning 6 Hours on a pint of oil.
  • Tracking: Its flame burns bright green while within roughly 300 feet of any Being of its bound Type. It gives no direction or distance.

Value: 200g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Pistol

Salvage from the Id Ascendant. Nobody in Icewind Dale has the faintest idea what it is. It has the following Powers:

  • Energy Bolt: Requires a charged Energy Cell. Firing expends 1 of the cell's 5 charges, and no one in the Dale can refill it.

Value: 2000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Rifle

Two-handed, absurdly precise, and utterly unrepairable this side of the stars. It has the following Powers:

  • Energy Lance: Requires a charged Energy Cell. Firing expends 1 of the cell's 5 charges.

Value: 3000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cloak (Bound)

Drakareth wore it, and it is a large part of why Drakareth was a problem. It has the following Powers:

  • (+2) Protection: +2 bonus to Saves against Spells and other magical effects.
  • Resistance: Favor on Saves and damage reduction against magical damage.

Value: 3500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Chain

Dwarven-made and light as cloth, it never announces the wearer the way steel does. It has the following Powers:

  • Featherweight: Counts as Chain armor, but never imposes Hinder on Checks to move quietly and has no Might requirement.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Necklace (Consumable)

Five beads on a chain, each one a small argument waiting to happen. It has the following Powers:

  • Fireball Beads: Detach a bead and throw it up to Far: it detonates for 3d6 Fire damage in a Near Sphere ([Reflex] to reduce). Multiple beads can be thrown at once, adding 1d6 each.

Value: 4000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Stone (Bound)

A fist-sized rock carved with an orcish eye, which watches back. It has the following Powers:

  • The Eyebiter's Shade: Once per Rest, summon the spirit of Vokarr the Eyebiter for 1 Hour. It answers questions about war and about orcs, and lies about everything else.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Pearl (Bound)

Sealed in an ancient tomb beneath Good Mead, alongside somebody who clearly wanted it kept there. It has the following Powers:

  • Recall: Once per Rest, regain Mana equal to a Spell you have already Cast.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Cloak (Bound)

The drow cut of the same enchantment, black as the Underdark and twice as smug about it. It has the following Powers:

  • Invisibility I: While the hood is up, skip your Move to become Invisible until after you take an Action. Beings have Hinder on Checks to notice you even after that.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description: The consumer gains the ability to control a type of Being they can see for 1 Hour, which requires their Focus. Once a Being is chosen, the consumer must make a Will Save. On a pass, the Being is Charmed and under their control for the duration. A Being controlled this way will not obey commands that clearly cause harm to itself. After this time, the Being becomes Hostile. This potion affects Beasts.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Amber, with a swirl of gold that never settles.

The consumer's physical age is reduced by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13. Each potion after the first carries a cumulative 10% chance of ageing them by the same amount instead.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
The liquid shifts colour depending on which element it was brewed against.

For 1 Hour, the consumer gains Favor on Saves and damage reduction against one damage type, chosen when the potion is brewed.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
A clear red liquid that pulses gently, like something with a heartbeat.

The consumer's Fatigue is removed, and they regain the full benefit of a Rest. For the next 24 Hours they regain the maximum result on any healing die rolled for them.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Vagabond has no Radiant damage type, so Rime's potion of radiant resistance is brewed here as a warding draught against magical damage.

For 1 Hour, the consumer gains Favor on Saves and damage reduction against magical damage.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
A cloudy green potion with a single seaweed frond drifting in it.

For 1 Hour, the consumer can breathe underwater. It does not grant a Swim speed.
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Orb

Once the pride and joy of Vellynne Harpell's collection, stolen out from under her by Nass Lantomir - who talks about it a great deal less than it talks about itself.

A smoky gray quartz sphere the size of a grapefruit, with pinpricks of silver light deep inside. Professor Skant is sentient, opinionated, and thinks everyone carrying it is a dunderhead - but it has no will of its own and can't pick fights on its own behalf.

It can Cast Kinesis at will, using it only to move itself around. Once per Round when you make a Check to recall lore on one of its four subjects (the history of Netheril, vampirism, the making of Elverquisst, or the tarrasque), you have Favor.

It has the following Powers:

  • Sentient Archive: The orb is sentient and speaks Common. It can answer questions on history, arcana and Netherese lore, and volunteers a great deal more than asked.
  • Telepathy: Telepathy (Close) with whoever carries it, which does not require Focus.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Crystal (Bound)

A shard of Netherese thought-crystal, humming faintly with the residue of a mind that stopped using it a very long time ago.

Bound Effect: Grants Telepathy for as long as you remain Bound to it, and glows with a soft purple light while worn.

It has the following Powers:

  • Telepathy: Telepathy (Far) while you remain Bound to it. The crystal glows a soft purple while worn.

Value: 10000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic

A three-compartment quiver, each compartment far deeper than the outside of it suggests.

  • Holding 3: Occupies 1 Inventory Slot, but can hold 3 Slots of Items without counting against the carrier's Inventory Slots.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Ring (Bound)

Worth more than gold on the Eastside of Termalaine, and everybody there knows it. It has the following Powers:

  • Resistance: Favor on Saves and damage reduction against Cold. The wearer is unharmed by Blistering Cold.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Ring (Bound)

A band of bronze cast as a curled ram's head, found in the wreck of a Netherese skycoach. It has the following Powers:

  • Ram's Charge: Holds 3 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to strike a Being within Far with a spectral ram: 2d10 damage and shoved 15 feet.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Tali's thanks for dealing with the thing in the lake. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.vlefpj16o0cazbYI]{Beast}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

From an Icewind kobold shaman's tent. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.oKWudg74hQmu9Ud7]{Cure}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Bundled with an archer figurine in the Dark Duchess's hold. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.O0K90e3VVZjgNGRW]{Dispel}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Confiscated from Dzaan, and offered back as a reward. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.TB8OU9AcPKGWBxwA]{Erupt}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Sealed in a chardalyn tube in the upside-down laboratory. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.iiWzQ25fr08ebdSY]{Fade}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

How Nass Lantomir knew what she knew. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.LqkoFJDOdDxlyT7R]{Guide}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Dropped down a waste chute, and none the worse for it. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.q52wvmwELTAsuPgM]{Knock}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Found on the crowned rooftop of Grimskalle. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.oKWudg74hQmu9Ud7]{Cure}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Scrivenscry's way into Ythryn, and possibly yours out. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.Yn7Qxij2UYVw5Djl]{Portal}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Scroll (Consumable)

No one has ever found a good reason to use this scroll on purpose. That has never stopped anyone from keeping one around, just in case a reason arrives.

Read this scroll as an Action to summon the Tarrasque in an unoccupied space you can see within 1 Mile. It disappears when reduced to 0 HP, and is hostile to everything but itself - including you.

It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Read it as an Action to summon the Tarrasque in an unoccupied space you can see within 1 Mile. It is hostile to everything, obeys no one, and vanishes at 0 HP. The scroll is consumed.

Value: 500000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Netherese archmages used comet-calling as a punchline to arguments. It's unclear whether they were joking.

Read this scroll as an Action while outdoors (or it's wasted) to bring a comet down on a point you can see within 1 Mile. It carves a 50-foot-deep, 500-foot-radius crater. Everything in that radius must pass [Reflex] or take 100 (30d10) damage, or half as much on a pass. All structures in the crater are destroyed, along with any unworn, unheld, nonmagical Objects.

It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Read it as an Action while outdoors to call a comet down on a point within 1 Mile, carving a 500-foot-radius crater. Everything in the radius must pass [Reflex] or take catastrophic damage. Indoors, the scroll is simply wasted. Consumed either way.

Value: 250000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)

system.description:
Lore: Relic Amulet (Bound)

Somewhere out in the ice, a construct is still waiting for whoever wears this. It has the following Powers:

Lore: Relic Tome

Written by Auril's own priesthood as a primer on her worship, its silver-gilt pages describe rites better left un-performed.

A thin, cold-to-the-touch tome bound in white ermine over white pine, sealed with a tarnished silver clasp. While it's in your possession, you have Immune: Cold.

A spellcaster who spends a Shift studying the Codicil learns the Frostburn Spell (if they don't already know it). Bound within its pages is also a poem, "Rime of the Frostmaiden" - an incantation whose true power is tied to a specific place and moment (GM's discretion).

It has the following Powers:

  • Auril's Ward: While the book is in your possession you are Immune to Cold.
  • Rites of the Frostmaiden: A Caster who studies it for a Shift adds @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.PHrsI0UrnCxQjjSq]{Freeze} and @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.GvDP0oYm6yPkkb6o]{Frostburn} to the Spells they know.

A spellcaster who spends a Shift studying it adds the following Spells to those they know, if they don't already: Animate, Confuse, Control, Disintegrate, Portal, and Raise.

It has the following Powers:

  • Iriolarthas's Curriculum: A Caster who studies it for a Shift adds @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.wD2EtvR22pIWlMqU]{Animate}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.tYMBjaX72424BZPW]{Confuse}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.pI3ezwxfgAetuy3w]{Control}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.plviZS0VEOdMNLkC]{Disintegrate}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.Yn7Qxij2UYVw5Djl]{Portal} and @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.lFubEdpr4iGi8BMw]{Raise} to the Spells they know, if they can Cast at that Rank.

system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Fixture

The beating heart of Ythryn, the floating Netherese city that fell from the sky and never quite finished crashing. Whatever the wizards who built it were reaching for, this was the thing they were reaching with.

An enormous crystal globe in an ornate cradle, shedding bright light to Far and dim light beyond that. This is a fixture, not a carried Item - it doesn't occupy Item Slots and can't be picked up. Up to 8 creatures can Bond to it by meditating near it for a Shift; all Bonded creatures sense whenever it's used, and any use requires the agreement of every Bonded creature.

While Bonded, a Being within Close can: fly the mythallar (and everything within 500') at Speed 30' as an Action; fully recharge one Relic within Close as an Action (once per Relic, until that Relic's charges return on a Rest); or Cast Control Weather with a 50-Mile radius, requiring no Mana or components as long as they stay within Close for the Casting.

Touching the globe itself deals 65 (20d6) damage (pass [Endure] for half); Undead have Hinder on this Save. Any Object that touches it - other than a Relic or the cradle - is destroyed instantly.

It has the following Powers:

  • Radiant III: Sheds bright light to Far and dim light well beyond it.
  • Mythallar: Powers every Netherese enchantment still running in Ythryn. Destroying it ends them all at once - including whatever is holding the city up.

Value: 0g

Ten-Towns is a sandbox — these run in any order, and most can be resolved without a fight.

ChapterGoalKey figuresEnds when
2 — Icewind DaleExplore the Dale, pick up an Arcane Brotherhood patron, find the road to Sunblight.Vellynne Harpell, Avarice, Dzaan's Simulacrum, Nass Lantomir's GhostThe party learns Xardorok is building something.
3 — SunblightInfiltrate the duergar fortress under Sunblight.Xardorok Sunblight, Grandolpha Muzgardt, Krob, F'yorlThe chardalyn dragon launches — whether or not the party is ready.
4 — Destruction's LightChase and stop the chardalyn dragon before it levels Ten-Towns.Chardalyn Dragon, Vellynne HarpellThe dragon is destroyed. Ten-Towns counts its dead.
5 — Auril's AbodeReach Solstice and break one of Auril's three forms.Auril (three forms), Gunvald Halraggson, Bjornhild Solvigsdottir, Isarr KronenstromAuril is beaten, or the party flees the island.
6 — Caves of HungerDescend toward the buried city.Tekeli-li, Yilsebek Dalambra, Hengar Aesnvaard, MjenirThe party reaches Ythryn.
7 — Doom of YthrynExplore the fallen Netherese city and deal with the Arch-Astronomer.Iriolarthas, Scrivenscry, Veneranda, the night hag covenThe mythallar's fate is decided. Roll credits.

Recurring threads

  • The Arcane Brotherhood — Vellynne, Avarice, Dzaan and Nass Lantomir all want the Codicil of White. Only one can be the party's ally.
  • Auril's winter — the sun does not rise until the campaign says it does. Roll on Weather — The Everlasting Rime each dawn.
  • Character secrets — each PC gets one from Appendix B. Vokarr the Eyebiter and Beldora are built for two of them.

Charges

Vagabond keeps bookkeeping low, so no item rolls to recover charges. Every charged item is 3 charges (wands, Ring of the Ram) or 5 charges (staffs, Abracadabrus), and they all come back in full after a Rest. Fixed-use items (Chime of Opening, Bag of Tricks, Necklace of Fireballs) were cut to 3–5 for the same reason.

Threat Level ≈ Challenge Rating

Every hand-converted creature was validated against Vagabond's own TL formula. TL is calibrated against the core compendium's scale rather than raw CR — core's Veteran is CR 3 at TL 2.4, and its Goblin is CR ¼ at TL 1.2 — so low-CR creatures naturally sit around TL 0.5–1.5.

Things Vagabond does not have

  • No Radiant or Force damage. Both are reflavoured as magical. Auril's radiant vulnerability became Fire; the potion of radiant resistance became the Potion of Warding.
  • No Necrotic or Psychic damage. Attacks that dealt them deal Magic damage; Immune lines still name them as a note for the GM.
  • No burrow speed. Burrowers (Remorhaz, Ice Piercer) describe it in an ability instead.
  • Small size means 1 HP per HD, and is reserved for rat-scale creatures. The Demilich and Flameskull are built Medium so they aren't crippled by it.
  • No boss HP doubling. Auril's forms and the Demilich reach their intended HP through a doubled effective HD instead.

Weather & cold

Roll Weather — The Everlasting Rime each dawn, and Blistering Cold — Exposure for anyone caught out without shelter or warmth. Cold Resistance items and the Ring of Warmth exist precisely to switch this off.

• Monsters — 207 stat blocks in eight sub-folders by Being Type.
  • NPCs — 229, split into Villains, Key NPCs, and one folder per chapter. 211 of them are named individuals built on a shared stat block; each one's sheet says which chassis it uses.
  • Magic Items — 67, in six folders (Bag of Holding, Helm of Telepathy, Potion of Cold Resistance, Potion of Gaseous Form, Potion of Healing, Potion of Invisibility, Potion of Superior Healing are left out: use the core Relics and Alchemical Items compendiums), priced from Vagabond's official Powers table.
  • Tables — six encounter tables by region, plus weather, cold exposure, scavenging and chwinga gifts.

Token dispositions

Monsters and Villains are Hostile. Key NPCs are Friendly. Everyone in a chapter folder defaults to Neutral, except the ones who are genuinely enemies (cultists, duergar, the Ythryn cast) — those are already set Hostile. Names show on hover: GM-only for monsters, everyone for NPCs.

Not included

No maps and no published adventure text — this module is stat blocks, items and reference only. You'll need the adventure itself to run it.
